Target's 10-K discloses no research-and-development expense line, in prose or in XBRL. Target sells private-label goods (including Up & Up) sourced from contract manufacturers rather than formulating its own products, so a company-wide R&D figure would not describe the same activity this project's other R&D rows measure.
Mary Kay Inc. is privately held and does not file a 10-K or publish an R&D figure.
